content: शकुनिः [शक्-उनि] .²1 A bird; तरुशकुनिकुरङ्गान् मैथिली यानपुष्यत् <ls>U. 3. 25</ls>; <ls>Ms. 12. 63</ls>. .²2 A vulture, kite or eagle. .²3 A cock. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of a son of Subala, king of Gāndhāra and brother of Gāndharī, wife of Dhṛtarāṣṭra; he was thus the maternal uncle of Duryodhana whom he assisted in many of his wicked schemes to exterminate the Pāṇḍavas. The name is now usually applied to an old wicked-minded relative whose counsels tend to ruin. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of a demon killed by Kṛṣṇa.
